purpose: Exploratory CPU smoke benchmark; not a model-accuracy study
prompt: Describe the visible surface in this image in 2 to 4 short sentences. Mention any visible cracks, their direction and the surface texture. If details are unclear, say so. conditions: Same source images and prompt, no detector context. Sequential workers and fresh model loads; OS file caches are not cleared. CPU, four threads, 140-token limit, greedy decoding / temperature zero. SmolVLM uses float32 and a single square 512px processor view. Qwen uses Ollama quantization and an aspect-preserving 512px thumbnail with native vision preprocessing. Exact runtime, digest, preprocessing and settings are saved per row. These are practical runtime configurations, not a controlled architecture-only comparison. Ollama process peak memory is unavailable.
